stories.title: Jayden Daniels' late TD keeps Commanders' NFC East hopes alive with win over Giants
stories.summary: New York couldn't close out a win against Washington, giving up a late touchdown drive. Its division lead is now shrinking.

stories.title: Scrutinized Daniels finds redemption with game-winning drive for Commanders
stories.summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels shook off two interceptions and multiple weeks of failed late-game drives to deliver when Washington needed him most.

stories.title: Cade authors NBA's first 50-point, 10-assist, 0-turnover game in 2OT thriller
stories.summary: Cade Cunningham had 52 points, 11 assists and no turnovers as the Pistons outlasted the Wizards in double overtime Thursday night.

stories.title: Sources: Pochettino agrees deal to replace Carrick at Man United
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has agreed to become the next Manchester United manager with an announcement expected on Friday, sources have told ESPN.

stories.title: Cubs' Crow-Armstrong, Astros' Alvarez sweep votes as unanimous MVP winners
stories.summary: Cubs star Pete Crow-Armstrong and the Astros' Yordan Alvarez each earned all 30 first-place votes to win the MVP awards in their respective leagues Thursday night.
